clips.title: The story
paras: Above Thelsamar, Thorgrum Borrelson tends the gryphons that carry travelers across Loch Modan. His roost links the valley with Ironforge and the mountain passes nearby.

Thorgrum Borrelson keeps the gryphon roost on the bluff above Thelsamar. His trained gryphons carry the Alliance across Loch Modan, where troggs and gnoll packs threaten the roads. They fly through South Gate Pass to the Great Forge in Dun Morogh, and onward toward the Wetlands and beyond.
